title: Craft & Chill
description: A modpack that aims to deliver a relaxing experience with beautiful visuals and calm environments.
body:
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fce162326223b41b1ae92e06cff140fafab7c78b.png)

# This modpack includes
- Complete visual upgrades from small world effects to stunning landscapes & nature.
- Complete animation overhaul with 'Fresh Animations' and multiple mods that provide satisfying breaking & placing of blocks.
- Multiple Quality of Life mods.
- e4mc mod to host or join easy multiplayer worlds for multiplayer.


# Additional Info
- I Recommend playing with the Complementary Shaders as it has no known bugs with any of the mods included. You can play with the other ones provided too (Photon and Eclipse) But they seem to have bugs when breaking blocks and some Mobs not looking right.

# Planned Content
- A fully fledged Quest tree with FTB Quests.


# _WARNING_
- You might need a pretty beefy pc to run this with the shaders included. I currently use a RTX 4070TI & Intel Core i7-10700KF and i get around 80-90 FPS average.
